title: Ordnungspolizei Doppelkasten radiogram A115, Mogilev, 16 June 1942 (Weierud 2020, NARA RG 457)

steps.what: Read both German key manuals and NSA articles; confirmed double pass from November 1941.
A115 has 223 letters, an odd count: 25 repeated digraphs counted from the end against 8 from the start put the stray letter among the first nine.
Known-plaintext solver recovers the boxes from about 80-111 pairs on synthetic data.
Key-free alignment of Hanyok's A115 text to its ciphertext over many spellings and layouts.
Borki located (Kirovsk district, Mogilev region; destroyed 15 June 1942), from a reader's pointer (Ilya) and Zhukov's history of the Dirlewanger unit, which gives the same 16 dead of Pol. Batl. 51.

Split from orpo1942 under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): A115 is in the daily key of 16 June 1942 (discriminator ARTTN), not the 27 Feb key, and its text exists as Bletchley's decrypt; the 27 Feb messages stay in orpo1942. align115c.py, align115h.py and hsspf_decrypt_1.png moved here.

outcome.method_basis: Bletchley decrypted A115 at the time; the decrypt, typed in German, is reproduced by Hanyok (NSA 2005). Nothing was deciphered here: the key-free alignment of the decrypt to the ciphertext failed, so the boxes were not recovered.
outcome.fraction_read_source: Bletchley's decrypt gives the whole message; it is not aligned letter by letter with the 223 cipher letters

gaps.item: The decrypt checked letter by letter against the 223 cipher letters, and the key
gaps.detail: The key-free alignment over spellings, separators, numbers, layouts and lengths found no consistent fit; the exact enciphered German wording or about 80 pairs from another source are needed.

outcome.notes: Read at the time by Bletchley. The report of the Borki massacre of 15 June 1942 (16 men of Pol. Batl. 51 killed; the village levelled and its inhabitants 'liquidated').

credits.note: Bletchley Park's decrypt of A115 (entry 21 of the German police decrypts of the day), NARA RG 457 HCC Box 1386, as reproduced by Hanyok (2005)
German Police Doppelkastenschlüssel Messages (CryptoCellar 2020): the A115 ciphertext and Red Forms from NARA RG 457
located Borki (Kirovsk district, Mogilev region) named in the A115 decrypt
